budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Two pairs of teammates compete to accumulate 12 relay pulses through physically adjacent supply conduits. Both relay sites may be captured by either team.
task.natural_termination: Any team reaches at least 12 cumulative pulses, including a simultaneous tie. Horizon 80 otherwise. No unique winner is fabricated for ties.
task.interaction: Building costs 2 carried units, repairing or cutting costs 1, handoffs require paired consent, and linked restocking drains shared team stock. Enemy occupation breaks connectivity immediately; isolated nonhome conduits decay every third tick. Defending a relay's tile can deny enemy occupation.
task.observation_access: All state is public and repeated in every role observation with an own-role one-hot. Ownership, supply links, occupation, stocks, pulses and map are actual kernel state. Every active site and agent is visible to all roles; rocks have inactive site masks.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Build or repair flags from the last nonabsorbing step
Durability attack flags from the last nonabsorbing step
Consented supply handoff participants from the last nonabsorbing step
Relay pulse flags from the last nonabsorbing step
Current enemy occupation of conduit sites

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
